card.name: Quotes and bids for contract work
card.fires_on: Words about asking for or giving a price quote or bid, such as quotation, tender, bid, estimate, or contractor, in service and contracting settings.

modes.label: Free quotation requests
modes.description: The word quotation or a word just before it in a request for a free price quote from a service business.
modes.example: Please get in touch for a free no obligation<< quotation>> for any of the above services or products

modes.label: Tender and bid verbs
modes.description: Verbs or nouns about submitting a tender, bid or estimate for work.
modes.example: three horologists were invited to<< tender>>.

modes.label: Contractor and cost wording
modes.description: Words about licensed contractors, costs and estimates in hiring talk.
modes.example: Inquire if the gardener is a licensed landscape<< contractor>>.

card.writes: It pushes words meaning quote or bid (报价, 投标), mostly in Chinese.
card.plain: It lights up when text talks about getting a price quote or bid for a job.
